```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(tibble)
library(janitor)
library(naniar)
library(dplyr)
library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)
library(shinythemes)
```

```{r}
gapminder<- read_csv("gapminder.csv")
```

```{r}

```


```{r}
library(shiny)

ui <- fluidPage( 
  
   selectInput("filter",
              "select continent",
              choices = unique(gapminder$continent),
              selected = "North America"),
    
  
  sliderInput("Range",
              label = "choose years",
              min =1980,
              max =  2022,
              value = 2000,
              step = 1,
              sep = "")
)


 fluidRow(
      box(
        title = textOutput("plot_title"),
        status = "info",
        solidHeader = T,
        width = 6,
        plotOutput("plot", height = "500px")
      ))

server <- function(input, output, session) {
   
  output$plot_title <- renderText(paste(input$filter, "throughout years"))
  
  output$plot <- renderPlot({
    
    gapminder %>% 
      filter(continent == input$filter,
             year >= input$Range[1],
             year <= input$Range[2]) %>% 
      ggplot(aes(x=gdp, y=life_expectancy, na.rm=T))+
      geom_boxplot()+
      scale_x_continuous(limits = input$Range)+
      theme(legend.position = "none",
            axis.text.x = element_text(hjust=1, size = 25),
            axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 1, size = 20))+
      labs(x="")
    })
  
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
